paragraphs: Herbal-Ai is a full-stack educational repository for documenting and sharing Philippine medicinal-plant knowledge. It combines a curated plant library, source-grounded AI assistance, community features, and an administrative review workflow. It is not a diagnostic service, a prescribing system, or an institutional DOH/PITAHC product.
